t: 教宗福莫苏斯加冕为卡林西亚的阿努尔夫为罗马皇帝. 阿努尔夫不久后中风,从意大利撤退.
te: Pope Formosus crowns Arnulf of Carinthia as Emperor in Rome. Arnulf suffers a stroke soon after and retreats from Italy.
